notes.title: Long Gone Days Welcomes New Patch with Simplified Chinese Support!
notes.content:
Hey there, everyone!

We're absolutely thrilled to share that the latest patch for Long Gone Days is now live, and the game is officially available in Simplified Chinese.

[b]Simplified Chinese Language Support:[/b]

With the addition of Simplified Chinese, we're opening the doors for even more players to embark on the emotional journey of our protagonist, Rourke. With today’s addition, you can now play Long Gone Days in English, French, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, German, Spanish (Latin America), Russian, or Portuguese (Brazil)!

Remember, if you come across any new issues, feel free to use our Discord server or the Bug Report Form here:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfXv306CP8JBND8m5xrzl3AKxy9M4Zv4SX00U-DHynkvX1XPA/viewform



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25870705/efdf785e0f4c7d74ee15e6a93d6d643dba71b785.png[/img]

notes.title: Long Gone Days Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 
We’re releasing a new patch for Long Gone Days in which we addressed several issues found by the community during this past week. We want to thank both our Discord community and everyone on the Steam Forums for being such a big help, by reporting every bug they’ve found. Thanks for taking the time to file a ticket and for your patience!

Some of the major issues being addressed are:

[list]
[*] Fixed black screen covering battle outside of the NSB HQ.
[*] Fixed issue causing a battle not resuming after a cutscene was displayed.
[*] Fixed stats possibly reaching negative values.
[*] Adjusted stat percentage gained or loss after using buffs and debuffs.
[*] Fixed softlock on Ivan’s house when interacting with a newspaper.
[*] Fixed event on PL Warehouse forcing the player to fight a battle again.
[*] Fixed “Encrypted” side quest progression being blocked.
[*] Adjusted target morale needed before starting “The Tickets” side quest.
[*] Fixed “Belladonna” being unable to be used on certain conditions.
[*] Fixed softlock related to picking up the medicine multiple times in Aleksander's apartment.
[*] Fixed party members' portraits not updating after reviving them in battle.
[/list]

This patch will also include fixes to other bugs regarding equipment items not displaying their correct stats, clipping and layering issues found on certain levels, corrections made to both localization and text not being translated by a party member and other minor fixes.

Remember to use our Discord server or the Bug Report post on the Steam Community forums if you find any new issues!

See you soon,
[i]LGD Team [/i]

notes.title: Long Gone Days Releases October 10
notes.content:
The news you’ve all been waiting for![b] Long Gone Days is fully releasing on Steam, on October 10th! [/b]

Not only that, but we’ve partnered with publisher Serenity Forge to release the game that very same day on Nintendo Switch, PS4/PS5 and Xbox Series X/S and Xbox One! 

Watch our shiny new announcement trailer:

[previewyoutube=OyHjKjGpt3w;full][/previewyoutube]

With this news, we are also adjusting the game price to reflect its launch price of $24.99. You’ll be able to buy it at this price before launch and can still play the Early Access build of the game. [b]If you already have the Early Access version, you'll get access to the full game at no extra cost![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25870705/d3c7c8128bfc273e7faada03a9f680ddc6318ace.png[/img]

Additionally, if you’re at PAX West this weekend, stop by the Serenity Forge booth (#1016) to play the game and meet one of the devs.

That's all for today’s update! Remember that you can follow us on:
[list]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/lgdays]Twitter[/url] 
[*] [url=http://discord.gg/longgonedays]Discord [/url] [/list]
And you can follow our publisher, Serenity Forge on:
[list]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/SerenityForge]Serenity Forge Twitter [/url]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/serenityforge  ]Serenity Forge Discord[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Chapters 2 & 3 are out NOW!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25870705/2d814115982aa70b4192357919c74f99c7b2ac3e.gif[/img]

Hi everyone! Our next big story update is finally here! Starting from today, you’ll be able to play[b] chapters 2 and 3[/b] of Long Gone Days.

In this chapter we’ll be able to explore a whole new city, and two new dungeons. You’ll also [b]get to know better[/b] your party members, and [b]meet[/b] some new ones too.

This new story update will add [b]4 more hours of gameplay[/b], with more people’s lives to change through sidequests, and more intriguing enemies to meet. 

This update will also feature a few changes to Chapter 1: Ivan will now help you in battle with a unique ability called [b]Boost[/b].

Boost has a chance to [b]buff [/b]one of his allies stats (attack, defense or agility), and it also has a chance to [b]heal [/b]them. Its effect will be determined by [b]Ivan’s equipment[/b], so be on the lookout for new items while exploring the world.

We also rebalanced all the battles and items you can find, to achieve a more consistent experience.

It is also important to note that old savefiles will no longer work. We have added a button on the title screen so you can continue playing from the ending of Chapter 1.

Here’s a change log for all the details:
1. [b]Chapter 2 & 3[/b] added
2. Added [b]PS4 & Xbox controller[/b] support
3.[b] Re-mapped keyboard keys[/b]. New controls are: X to accept, C to cancel/open menu, V to fast forward dialogues, and arrow keys to move.
4. Added “[b]Chapter 2[/b]” button to title screen to start playing from there
5. Changed[b] title screen[/b]
6. Changed [b]game over[/b] screen
7. Changed [b]Lynn and Ivan’s portraits[/b]
8. Increased [b]Rourke’s base speed[/b] (walking and running)
9. Made [b]Ivan usable during battles[/b] (starting from chapter 1)
10. Rebalanced [b]items [/b]quantity
11. Rebalanced [b]equipment [/b]stats
12. Rebalanced [b]enemies[/b]
13. Fixed lots of small, medium, and large [b]bugs [/b]reported by the community
14. Fixed minor English/Russian [b]grammar mistakes/typos[/b] reported by the community

As always, remember you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/LongGoneDays]Discord[/url], or follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/lgdays]Twitter[/url], [url=http://lgdays.tumblr.com]Tumblr[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/LongGoneDaysGame/]Facebook[/url] for more frequent updates!

Cheers,
[i]LGD Team[/i]

notes.title: Next Update on July 25!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that our next big story update is coming out next month!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25870705/96c5081462ddd4697fa6761495b08ec0f7cb6a77.gif[/img]

On July 25th, the game will be [b]automatically updated on Steam[/b]. Several changes and improvements were made to the first chapter, so we recommend playing it from the beginning, but otherwise, we'll add an option to start directly from Chapter 2.

We’ll write a more detailed log on July 25, but here are some of the things included in this update:
[list]
[*][b]PS4 and Xbox controllers[/b] are now supported
[*]Rourke’s [b]walking speed[/b] has been raised
[*]Battles, equipment, items and rewards have been [b]rebalanced[/b]
[*][b]Ivan [/b]can now be used in battle
[*][b]Lynn [/b]and [b]Ivan’s [/b]portraits have been revamped (See [url=https://i.imgur.com/UVEEOqf.png]here[/url] and [url=https://i.imgur.com/zYNbEPM.png]here[/url])
[*]About [b]3~4 hours of new content[/b] (which means the game is now about 8 hours long)
[*]More instances to [b]get to know[/b] your party members
[*]More [b]narrative-focused sidequests[/b]
[*]Lots of [b]bug fixes[/b] that have been reported by our players
[/list]

We also want to take the opportunity to thank everyone who has helped us with feedback using the Steam community forums and our Discord server, none of this would have been possible without you!

See you all next month!

As always, remember you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/LongGoneDays]Discord[/url], or follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/lgdays]Twitter[/url], [url=http://lgdays.tumblr.com]Tumblr[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/LongGoneDaysGame/]Facebook[/url] for more frequent updates!

Cheers,
[i]LGD Team[/i]

As you might already know, Long Gone Days is [b]4 chapters[/b] long, and we have already released chapter 1. notes.title: Long Gone Days 0.1.4 - Bug Fixes + Additional Dialogues
notes.content:
We’re pushing a small update to the game that fixes some minor issues reported on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/510540/discussions/0/1698294337793062502/]Bug Report Thread[/url].

[b]Some of the fixes included with this update are:[/b]
- Added new interactions, new NPC art and additional dialogues to some sidequests in Kaliningrad.
- Fixed some instances where the player didn't gain Morale after finishing a sidequest.
- Fixed typos and grammatical errors in English and Russian texts.
- Fixed some missing collisions in Kaliningrad.

We know there are still some minor pending bugs and features left, but rest assured they are still being worked on. And of course, we are also working on Chapter 2, so here's a little sneak peek of one of the new maps:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25870705/f497cfa36feec946bb85a91728fb6944ce8001a3.png[/img]

As always, remember you can follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/lgdays]Twitter[/url], [url=http://lgdays.tumblr.com/]Tumblr[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/LongGoneDaysGame/]Facebook[/url] for more frequent updates! Thank you so much for your incredible support, everyone!

Cheers, 
[i]LGD Team[/i]

notes.title: Long Gone Days 0.1.3 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
We've updated the game with fixes to most of the bugs and issues that have been reported from the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/510540/discussions/0/1698294337793062502/]Bug Report Thread[/url].

[b]Some of the fixes included with this update are:[/b]
- Fixed typos and grammatical errors in English and Russian texts.
- Capped the FPS to 60.
- Add visual and sound effects to healing items used in battle.
- Fixed the item "Sweet Cookies", which wasn't working as intended.
- Fix collision on one of the Forest Maps that allowed the player to reach unintented locations.

We're still working on adding an option to [b]remap the game controls[/b], and also adding [b]controller support[/b].

We want to thank everyone who's played the game so far and has taken the time to report all of these issues!

Cheers,
LGD Team.

notes.title: Simplified Chinese Demo Released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25870705/f6c95d437373a5b9f7b788b5ebc1761db142925e.jpg[/img]

Good news! The Simplified Chinese version of the demo has been released, thanks to Indienova [url=https://www.indienova.com/corp/gutenberg]Project Gutenberg[/url]'s team:

Alwaysmadowl, 潦倒困, West, 乱堆糖果, 一只小雨, benzoin, Gabriel, 烤焦面包, Canny, KENNY FENG, 阿V是只牛, craft, 南佐, daqicheng, SisseL, Paledust, shawn.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25870705/b109e965afc323ed1c571add827ad9daccfbc876.jpg[/img]


[h1]Changing the language of the game[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25870705/0014c45883700ffeba28f32c8e1d3d9b9b93d927.png[/img]

1. Select the game from your Steam library and right click to select "Properties"
2. Go to the "Languages" tab.
3. From the drop-down menu, select the language you want to use.
4. Click "ok".
5. If the game supports the language of your choice, a 6MB patch will be downloaded.
